items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: This drummer that I met, he was a great show drummer, playing shows -- his name was Battleaxe.

ctx.x: 28 inches, that's a huge... That's like the ones that you carry in front of you in a marching band.

Yes. And during that time, Zutty Singleton, he was using a 28-inch. This drummer that I met, he was a great show drummer, playing shows -- his name was Battleaxe. He used an overhead pedal. The pedal was round and it fastened on the top of the bass drum. He would beat it (?). Something like the alligator foot pedal.
